item.summary: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah addressed the Uttarakhand State Foundation Day celebrations in Dehradun today. On this occasion, Uttarakhand Chief Minister Shri Pushkar Singh Dhami, along with several other distinguished dignitaries, was also present.
item.title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah addresses Uttarakhand State Foundation Day celebrations in Dehradun
